description: This file contains internal API implementations for the COSA Security Data Model, including creation, initialization, removal, and registration functions for security and access policies. It manages the persistent storage of security configurations and related policies using a folder-based IREP structure, and deals with data structures representing policies, URLs, keywords, and applications.

classes.name: COSA_DATAMODEL_SECURITY
classes.description: Data model structure for security configurations, including firewall and access policy data, and folder handles for persistent storage.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE CosaSecurityCreate(VOID)
methods.description: Allocates and initializes the security data model object, setting up function pointers and preparing the object for use.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaSecurityInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Performs initialization routines for the security object, including loading configurations from persistent storage and setting up in-memory data structures.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaSecurityRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Cleans up and frees all resources associated with the security object, including policies, logs, and folder handles.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaSecurityIARegGetInfo(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Retrieves registered access policies and updates the in-memory data structures to reflect stored persistent configurations.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaSecurityIARegAddInfo(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * pNextInsNumName,ULONG ulNextInsNum,char * pPreffix,ULONG ulUpperInsNum,char * pAlias,ANSC_HANDLE hCosaContext)
methods.description: Adds information entries into the persistent storage for new policies or sub-entries, including URL, keyword, or app data.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaSecurityIARegDelInfo(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hCosaContext)
methods.description: Deletes a policy or sub-entry from the persistent storage based on the provided context handle.

ctags.name: CosaSecurityIARegAddInfo
ctags.signature: (ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * pNextInsNumName,ULONG ulNextInsNum,char * pPreffix,ULONG ulUpperInsNum,char * pAlias,ANSC_HANDLE hCosaContext)
